name: SectionDrawer
description: Compose a section navigation drawer with header, search, groups, items, body and footer slots.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name: "Assistant navigation".

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: subtitle

slots.name: Search
slots.signature: ({ value, onValueChange, noun, placeholder, }: SectionDrawerSearchProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: noun
props.description: What the list holds, plural: "organisations" names the field "Search organisations".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new query as the person types, and with "" when Esc clears the field. Pair with `value`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: query
props.description: The search: its first occurrence in `text` is highlighted, ignoring case.

props.name: text
props.description: Plain text rendered or copied by the component.

props.name: fill
props.description:
The body does not scroll; its last child fills the remaining height and scrolls itself
(a virtualised Tree), so the drawer never shows two scrollbars.

slots.name: Item
slots.signature: ({ icon, label, count, detail, active, render, face, className, onClick, ...rest }: SectionDrawerItemProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current destination or active choice.

props.name: count
props.description: Tabular count at the trailing edge.

props.name: detail
props.description: Data subtitle under the label (a user, a path).

props.name: face
props.description:
The row's face, drawn instead of icon, label and detail: an entity identity at its row
tier (OrganisationIdentity, DeviceIdentity), so the drawer shows the entity exactly as a
table does. `label` stays its plain name.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible or accessible label for this component.

props.name: render
props.description: Render as a router link: render={<Link to="…" />}. Default: a button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
